svg.title: Contribution field: 874 contributions from 10 AUG 2025 to 10 AUG 2026
svg.desc: A 53-week grid of daily GitHub contributions where the area and glow of each dot are proportional to that day's contribution count. 163 of 366 days were active. The busiest day was 4 JUN 2026 with 23 contributions.
